glue.description: configure the server's request timeout (a cap on wall time, not a bound on work)

notes: No glue can add a bound; the combination carries OPA's timeout configuration cell unchanged (WITH-WORK, zero lines). OPA cell: opa run --server over loopback HTTP, 100000 requests: min/median/p95/max ns 101008/301984/540673/1572898; includes the HTTP round trip and JSON on both sides. Rego evaluation has no stated worst case bound and no bound travels with a policy; a request timeout caps wall time, which the pre registered rubric counts as WITH-WORK.
